english.meaning: when you think back over something again
english.note: Used as in 諗返轉頭, thinking it over again.

exampleSentences.english: But thinking back, I realized the thieves were just too skilled.
exampleSentences.traditional: 但係我諗返轉頭都諗到係因為，即係我諗啲賊真係即係，太過純熟嚹。
